text:
priya: Quick check — launching webinar + benchmark blog next week. Can we confirm SEO + routing plan? I sketched priorities but want owners.

Tom: +1 on owners. Main things we need: keyword map for blog + webinar page, JSON-LD for Event, canonicalization (webinar url -> blog canonical?), internal linking (from product pages), and redirect matrix for old webinar drafts.

elaine: I can own schema + meta. For the webinar landing we'll need Event schema + multiple offers (recording + signup). Also plan FAQ schema for SEO snippets. I'll drop a sample JSON-LD later.

sam: I'll own keyword mapping and meta descriptions. Early ask — target long-tail keywords: "low-latency LLM inference cost", "dedicated GPU LLM serving" and a webinar-specific phrase like "live demo: inference at scale". Want one primary and two supporting per page.

priya: @sam perfect. Can you also map search intent -> CTA (e.g., learn vs sign up vs trial)? We need to wire UTM params so inbound routing goes to HubSpot and SFDC lead flows.

jamal: On redirects: we have 3 old landing URLs from the alpha tests. Recommend 301 to the new canonical webinar page. I'll publish a redirect matrix in the repo and run smoke tests.

Tom: Routing note: landing -> /webinars/inference-at-scale/ with utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=inference2026. HubSpot form must set hidden field "source_channel=webinar" and trigger SFDC lead assignment to AE team. @jamal can you confirm HubSpot form field names match SFDC mapping?

jamal: Yup I'll confirm. Also adding a short redirect check we can run: `curl -I https://old.example.com/alpha-webinar | grep -i location` to validate 301 location header.

elaine: Sample JSON-LD for Event (first pass):
```
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Inference at Scale — Live Demo",
  "startDate": "2026-06-10T16:00:00Z",
  "endDate": "2026-06-10T17:00:00Z",
  "eventStatus": "https://schema.org/EventScheduled",
  "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.example/webinars/inference-at-scale/"},
  "offers": {"@type": "Offer", "url": "https://redwood.example/webinars/inference-at-scale/register", "price": "0"}
}
```
I'll attach an FAQ snippet next.

sam: Good start. For meta title drafts: "Inference at Scale | Live demo of Redwood Dedicated" and shorter option for SERP. I'll post 3 variants in the doc and we can A/B through Search Console performance.

priya: Internal linking plan: add contextual CTA from product pages (Serving Runtime, Dedicated) and blog cluster pages. Also add a side rail to the benchmark narrative with anchor links to the webinar sign-up. @tom please add a redirect-safe anchor strategy — anchors shouldn't be relied on for redirects.

Tom: Noted. We'll avoid using anchors as canonical redirect targets. Also update sitemap.xml with the webinar URL and ping GSC via API after publishing. I'll add to release checklist.

jamal: Testing checklist I propose: 1) Redirect smoke test for old URLs, 2) JSON-LD validation (Rich Results Test), 3) GSC sitemap submit, 4) HubSpot form -> SFDC lead roundtrip test, 5) canonical tag check (page HTML). I can run 1 & 4.

elaine: I'll run 2 & 5. For the FAQ schema I'll keep Qs short to avoid truncation in snippets.

priya: Who's OK to publish the redirect matrix and keyword doc by EOD Thursday? We need final copies for the launch checklist.

sam: I can finish keyword doc by EOD Thursday.

jamal: I'll publish redirect matrix by EOD Thursday and add the curl smoke script to the ops repo.

Tom: I'll add sitemap + GSC steps to the launch playbook and tag the release.

elaine: I'll finish JSON-LD and FAQ schema Thurs morning and post the snippet in the doc.

priya: Great — last item: messaging iteration. We'll run two subject lines for the webinar invite and track CTR in GA4. I want a short test plan in the marketing doc (duration 48h, kpi = CTR>15%). Who will implement?

sam: I'll set up the A/B subject lines in the email tool and add tracking.

priya: Thanks all. I'll consolidate owners into the launch checklist and ping again at standup. :rocket:
